matrix.input: KeyV and right mouse; normal W movement on both stair directions

performance.limit: 1280x720 headless Chromium D3D11, 180 RAF intervals per stage at a 60Hz presentation cap. The archived Medium reference is PR21, not exact main A/B. Its restored stage and current Medium restored stage are post-orbit views, not clear-view restoration proof. High clear stage does verify restoration. Ordinary encounter spawn explains coincident resource changes; this is not a universal hardware or GPU-time guarantee.
